subject: How to add minor log ticks to only one axis in ggplot

messages.author: c9147388ebda8df0
messages.subject: How to add minor log ticks to only one axis in ggplot
parts:
Hi,
I want to customise the number of minor log ticks in only my x axis. Other axis is categorical variable.

I tried using annotation log tick but it by default works for two axes and there’s a lr argument that also works on two axes.

Any suggestions would be useful.

Thanks,
Amith

messages.author: d4bd59918e91a02b
messages.subject: Re: How to add minor log ticks to only one axis in ggplot
parts:
Hi,
This also puzzle me. you simply use annotation_logticks, sides "b" for bottom, "t" for top or the combination of these to both or more. See below:

sides

a string that controls which sides of the plot the log ticks appear on. It can be set to a string containing any of "trbl", for top, right, bottom, and left. ref: https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/annotation_logticks.html
